QuestInfo.name: A brave warrior to defeat King Clang appears!
QuestInfo.1: Complaining Riel soon lightens up and says that a brave warrior must appear to rescue the beautiful girl in distress. Therefore, she asks me to take the role of the warrior and defeat King Clang. What have I done to get myself into these situations!? I'm not the warrior type, but the least I can do is help defeat #rKing Clang#k. \n\n#o5220000# #r#a21611##k
QuestInfo.2: Defeated King Clang and came back to Riel. Riel joyfully says that a brave warrior saved her. It really wasn't for her sake, but Florina Beach is finally back to its peaceful state.

0.0: Oh my... I've lost the bet, and it's all because of you! I've always wanted to be the beautiful maiden that sacrifices herself to save her village. I will never forgive you! How could you disappoint me like this?!
0.1: What? No, no. All the endings of this kind of story include a brave and handsome #bwarrior#k that comes to rescue the beautiful maiden in distress and defeats the monster! There still is a way!
0.2: Adventurer! It's up to you to complete this story with a happy ending! A warrior throwing himself to save the damsel is always heroic! You must take this role!

yes.0: I must admit, the story unraveling is somewhat different from what I planned, but this has its own merits to it too. Adventurer... no I mean, warrior! Please defeat #rKing Clang#k, and save the damsel!

no.0: No, how could you?! How can you turn down a great role like this! You are no fun at all!

1.0: You've come back, warrior! I, #bRiel#k, was worried sick over you and couldn't sleep at all! \r\n#L0# #b(Absorbed in the role already!)#l
1.1: Oh, I'm so happy to see you again. Thank you, thank you very much! How can I pay you for your deed? What? You don't need anything?\r\n#L0# #b(... I didn't say a word!)#l
1.2: You are brave but also modest. You truly are a real warrior! I will never forget your name!

yes.0: I will sing a song of a brave young warrior who never hesitated to rescue the beautiful island girl from the dreadful monster! Oh, how could you be so courageous?

mob.0: You haven't defeated #rKing Clang#k yet? If it's a burden to you... you may back out, warrior. You don't need to throw yourself to save little old me... sniffle...
